description: MONITOR CHANGES: Register a supported canonical GOV.UK page for recurring checks and stored snapshots. Fourteen-day free trial allows 1 custom page; £4.99 one-off 30-day pilot allows 3. Initial baseline is attempted immediately; if unavailable it is queued. First snapshot is not a change event. For a one-call private digest use my_watch_changes and save next_cursor. No guaranteed check interval or built-in email or ChatGPT alert; paid keys may configure an optional signed HTTPS webhook through the API.

api_key.description: Optional UKSI API key (usi_...). Prefer supplying Authorization: Bearer KEY in MCP connection settings rather than exposing paid keys in tool calls.

url.description: Full canonical https://www.gov.uk/ URL for a supported Content API page.

name: watch_govuk_page
